text.brief: On a February morning in 2030, the master of an LNG carrier bound for Taichung receives a radio call from a China Coast Guard cutter. The caller asks for his manifest under the "customs regulations of the Taiwan region" and tells him to stand by for inspection.
text.record: Taiwan held about eleven days of liquefied natural gas in reserve in April 2026 against a target of fourteen ([AmCham Taiwan](https://topics.amcham.com.tw/2026/04/energy-security-returns-to-the-forefront/)). The island shut its last nuclear reactor in May 2025, and its regulator cleared an initial restart plan for Maanshan in September 2026. The PLA's Justice Mission 2025 exercise rehearsed a blockade of Keelung and Kaohsiung.
text.reading: A quarantine is not a blockade, and the difference matters to insurers, shipowners and lawyers. The China Coast Guard enforces "domestic customs law" on energy cargoes and lets food and medicine pass. Each carrier that submits a manifest concedes the Party's jurisdiction, and each delay burns a day of gas. This is Stratagem 19, remove the firewood from under the pot.
text.coreEvent: The China Coast Guard declares an inspection regime for shipping bound for Taiwan before 2033.
text.gapText: Technology Architecture. Taiwan's power system runs on a fuel that arrives by sea every few days and that Taiwan can store for barely two weeks.
text.fix: Lengthen the clock with storage and nuclear power, and pre-arrange escorts and insurance so no carrier has to choose between its cargo and its crew.
